legal_privacy_meta_description: How {siteName} handles face photos, account details and video downloads, including AI processing, browser storage and the 2-day upload retention period.
legal_privacy_title: Privacy for your photos, account and videos
legal_privacy_intro: This policy covers {siteName} at {host}. When you place a face photo into one of the five band roles, the service needs to store that upload and send it for AI processing. The sections below explain that journey, the information attached to your account and how to request deletion.
legal_privacy_collect_account: your email identifies the account used to buy credits and retrieve videos. If Google sign-in is offered and you choose it, we also receive the name and profile image supplied through that sign-in.
legal_privacy_collect_photos: the face images you upload are stored so they can be assigned to lead, sax, keys or a backing-vocal role. They are used to produce your requested video, not for a separate purpose.
legal_privacy_collect_videos: we retain the completed output with your account so you can return to watch and download it.
legal_privacy_collect_payments: Stripe processes the payment. Our records include the purchase, its amount and the associated email. We do not receive your complete card number.
legal_privacy_collect_technical: the hosting service processes IP addresses, browser details and request logs. Referral links and campaign tags help us understand which links brought visitors to the generator.
legal_privacy_processors_cloudflare: Cloudflare runs the website, stores uploaded files and outputs, and delivers sign-in emails.
legal_privacy_processors_stripe: Stripe handles checkout and payment processing; payment details entered there are processed by Stripe.
legal_privacy_processors_google: Google participates in authentication only if Google sign-in is available and you select it.
legal_privacy_processors_ai: Our AI video provider receives the reference photos needed to render the requested face replacements. The upload retention period below describes our own storage, not a separate retention promise on the provider’s behalf.
legal_privacy_processors_no_sale: We do not sell your information or use advertising cookies. Sending photos to the video provider is part of fulfilling the generation request.
legal_privacy_retention_photos: Uploaded face photos are removed from our storage within 2 days. This is separate from the storage of a completed video.
legal_privacy_retention_videos: Completed videos remain available through your account until you ask us to delete them.
legal_privacy_retention_records: Account information is retained while the account exists. Payment records are retained for the period required by applicable tax law.
legal_privacy_cookies_heading: Cookies and the band saved in your browser
legal_privacy_cookies_body: First-party cookies keep you signed in and remember the referring link for 60 days. The generator also uses browser session storage for selected photo references, stage selections and the parody checkbox so a reload or checkout return can restore the band. Phone-upload handoff details are held for the session, and your preferred upload method can be remembered in local storage. These browser functions are separate from deleting uploaded files on our servers. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.
legal_privacy_choices_heading: Request a copy, deletion or account closure
legal_privacy_choices_body: Contact the support address at the end of this page to request a copy of your information, removal of saved videos or closure of your account. Identify the account email and, for a particular video, include its link so we can find it. We respond within 30 days. {siteName} is for adults: users and people in uploaded photos must be at least 18.
legal_privacy_changes_body: When this privacy policy changes, its last-updated date changes too. Use the related pages below for the rules on sharing a result or requesting a refund.
legal_terms_meta_description: Terms for using {siteName}: photo permissions, adult-only parody, one-time credit packs, AI limitations and sharing videos without implied endorsement.
legal_terms_title: Terms for creating and sharing your band video
legal_terms_intro: These terms apply when you use {siteName} to upload photos, purchase a credit pack or generate a video. The service edits a predefined Outstanding performance clip; it is not an open-ended video editor or an official concert service.
legal_terms_service_heading: The service and the source performance
legal_terms_service_body: {siteName} provides an independent tool for AI parody edits of the Outstanding Tiny Desk clip. Use is for personal, non-commercial sharing. NPR, Tiny Desk Concerts, Charlie Wilson and The Gap Band do not operate, endorse or sponsor this service; Tiny Desk is an NPR trademark. Rights in the reference footage and music remain with their owners. A payment buys generation credits, not ownership of that footage, a music licence or permission to use the result in advertising. Rights-holder removal requests are handled through the DMCA process linked below.
legal_terms_photos_heading: Who can appear in the edit
legal_terms_photos_public_figures: Obvious parody featuring public figures—including coaches, players and celebrities—is permitted by this service’s rules. That permission does not transfer any rights belonging to the people depicted or to other rights holders.
legal_terms_photos_no_minors: Everyone in an uploaded photo must be 18 or older. Do not upload a private person’s photo when they would not agree to appear in the video.
legal_terms_photos_rights: You retain the rights you hold in your photographs. Uploading gives us permission to use them to carry out the requested generation, not for unrelated uses.
legal_terms_usage_personal: You may share a result as a personal, non-commercial parody—for example in a group chat, a personal social post or at a private party.
legal_terms_usage_restrictions: Do not present an AI edit as a genuine performance, use it to harass or embarrass someone, or place it in an advertisement or endorsement.
legal_terms_usage_platforms: A social platform may mute the soundtrack or remove a post under its own music and content rules. Generating a video here does not override those rules.
legal_terms_credits_heading: What a credit pack pays for
legal_terms_credits_body_before: Generation uses credits bought in one-time packs. There is no subscription, credits do not expire, and the price is displayed before checkout. Credits are not cash and cannot be redeemed for money except under the
legal_terms_credits_body_after: . The policy distinguishes automatic credit returns from refunds to the original payment method.
legal_terms_ai_body: The model aims to carry the uploaded face into the reference performance; it does not promise a frame-perfect copy of the person. Likeness and motion can vary with the image. A provider may refuse a photo or request, and a refused generation returns the credits used for that video.
legal_terms_refusal_body_before: We may refuse a generation, remove material or close an account when these terms are breached. We also remove material in response to valid rights-holder notices. The reporting and counter-notice process is described on the
legal_terms_warranty_body: The service is supplied as is. Where the law permits a limitation of liability, our total liability to you is limited to the amount you paid us during the preceding 12 months.
legal_terms_changes_body: The date at the top records the latest revision. Continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.
legal_refunds_meta_description: {siteName} refund rules: automatic credits for failed renders, 14-day refunds for unused packs, and a 7-day reporting window for technically broken videos.
legal_refunds_title: Video refunds and returned generation credits
legal_refunds_intro: A purchase on tinydeskaigenerator.org is a one-time credit pack, not a subscription. The right next step depends on whether a render failed, a pack is still unused or a completed video has a technical problem. A credit return restores your generation balance; a payment refund goes back to the original payment method.
legal_refunds_failed_heading: A render fails, is refused or is cancelled
legal_refunds_failed_body: If generation fails, the model refuses it, or you cancel before it finishes, the credits spent on that video return to your account automatically. This does not by itself send money back to a card. You do not need to submit a request for the automatic credit return.
legal_refunds_unused_heading: You have not used a purchased pack
legal_refunds_unused_body: If no credits from the pack have been used, email support within 14 days of purchase. An eligible unused-pack refund returns the full purchase price to the payment method originally used.
legal_refunds_broken_heading: A completed video has a technical defect
legal_refunds_broken_body: Report a clearly broken result within 7 days and include its video link. Examples include the wrong face, a frozen or garbled shot, or missing audio in the version that should contain the song. We return the credits or refund that video. The intentionally silent download is a separate output, not an audio fault.
legal_refunds_broken_likeness: A recognizable but imperfect likeness is an expected AI limitation, not automatically a broken result. The generator aims for similarity and cannot promise an exact duplicate of the uploaded face.
legal_refunds_ask_heading: What to include in your support email
legal_refunds_ask_body_after: from your account email. State whether you need help with an unused pack or a completed video; include the purchase date and any order reference you have, plus the video link and a short description for a result problem. Card refunds normally appear within 5 to 10 business days. Contact us before opening a chargeback so we can investigate directly.
legal_refunds_no_subscription: {siteName} uses one-time packs only. There is no recurring plan to cancel, and unused credits do not expire.
legal_dmca_meta_description: Report copyrighted material or an unwanted likeness on {siteName}. Find the support contact, notice checklist, response process and counter-notice guidance.
legal_dmca_intro: This page is the reporting route for content on {siteName}, including a displayed sample or a generated-video link. If your copyrighted work is used without permission, send a copyright notice. If a video depicts you without your agreement, use the simpler likeness-removal route below.
legal_dmca_notice_body_after: with “DMCA” in the subject. To help us locate the material and assess the notice, include:
legal_dmca_notice_work: The copyrighted work you own or represent, and the specific page or video URL on {siteName} that you want removed; identify the material precisely enough for us to locate it.
legal_dmca_notice_contact: Your name, mailing address, telephone number and email address.
legal_dmca_notice_good_faith: A statement of your good-faith belief that the disputed use is not authorised by the rights holder, its agent or the law.
legal_dmca_notice_perjury: A statement that the information is accurate and, under penalty of perjury, that you own the relevant right or are authorised to act for its owner.
legal_dmca_notice_response: We act on complete notices within 2 business days and notify the account holder. A direct link is important: a description of the meme alone may not identify the particular file or page.
legal_dmca_likeness_heading: Ask us to remove a video that depicts you
legal_dmca_likeness_body: If you appear in a video made on this service without your agreement, email support with the video link and explain that it depicts you. You do not need to prepare a formal copyright notice for this request; we remove the video.
legal_dmca_counter_heading: If you believe a copyright removal was a mistake
legal_dmca_counter_body: Reply to the removal notice with a counter-notice identifying the removed material and its former location, your physical or electronic signature, and a statement under penalty of perjury that you have a good-faith belief the removal resulted from mistake or misidentification. Include your name, address and telephone number, the applicable federal-court jurisdiction consent and agreement to accept service of process required by Section 512. We forward the counter-notice, including its contact information, to the original notice sender. The official guidance linked below explains the required jurisdiction statement for people inside and outside the United States.
legal_dmca_repeat_body: Accounts that repeatedly upload material they do not have the right to use are closed. Describing an edit as parody does not stop a rights holder or a depicted person from using the reporting routes on this page.
legal_dmca_official_guidance: U.S. Copyright Office: notice and counter-notice requirements
legal_request_safety: For support requests, do not send passwords, sign-in codes or a full payment-card number.
